method: Every HQ counterexample was reproduced against this branch's owner BEFORE repair; all four reproduced exactly.

A_projection_trust_moved_outward.reproduced: OwnerStateProjection(owner=..., producer_state='SUPPORTED', retained_state='VALID_EMPTY', ...) .as_evidence() minted trusted ProducerStateEvidence. OwnerStateProjection.derive(derive_fn=<caller fn>) returned a caller-chosen retained state.
correction: OwnerStateProjection is token-guarded: direct construction raises OwnerProjectionError.

The generic derive/derive_fn injection point was DELETED. No public, private or keyword route accepts arbitrary projection logic; each typed factory calls its own fixed classification function directly.
Typed factories only: from_empirical_fact, from_discovery_receipt, from_adaptive_result, from_recursive_handoff, from_empirical_integrity_refusal, from_blocked_authority_refusal.
The fixture no longer reconstructs a projection to substitute supporting_refs. from_adaptive_result now carries the owner's own unvisited, visited and determinant refs as explicit fields.

B_owner_refusal_projection_overbroad.reproduced: An arbitrary ValueError minted BLOCKED_REQUIRED_AUTHORITY, and an exception whose name merely contained 'Integrity' was classified as INTEGRITY_FAILURE by class-name substring.
correction: Refusals are classified by EXACT type identity, never by class-name substring and never by default.
from_empirical_integrity_refusal requires exactly Pre553IntegrityError.
from_blocked_authority_refusal requires exactly Pre553AuthorityError.
from_owner_refusal (the heuristic) was removed entirely.

IMPORTANT: Pre553AuthorityError SUBCLASSES Pre553IntegrityError. An isinstance-based check would silently collapse BLOCKED_REQUIRED_AUTHORITY into INTEGRITY_FAILURE, so exact-type identity is mandatory. The integrity factory actively refuses a Pre553AuthorityError and directs the caller to the blocked factory; a court asserts the subclass relation and the refusal.

C_route_obligation_forgeable_or_omittabl.reproduced: A directly constructed RouteObligation passed assert_route_not_laundered's isinstance gate, and build_state_route_result accepted route_class=LEARNED_OR_ADJUDICATED_REQUIRED with route_obligation=None.
correction: RouteObligation is token-guarded; only from_structural_admission may mint one.
A LEARNED_OR_ADJUDICATED_REQUIRED envelope with no obligation now raises RouteLegitimacyError.
A competent DIRECT_EMPIRICAL route still requires no obligation and carries no authority.
The positive factory still binds receipt, authority, exact empirical fact, exact rule hash when ADMITTED, receipt-declared target use, decision/reason and blocking refs.
For ADMITTED, a requested-use claim is not accepted as granted authority: target_use is taken from the receipt.
For a negative evaluation whose receipt truthfully says UNRESOLVED_STRUCTURAL_USE, that exact value is preserved; the requested use is never invented as granted authority.
The old acceptance court test_at15_route_label_alone_creates_no_authority was REPLACED by the hostile test_repair_hq_a_learned_route_without_an_obligation_is_refused.

D_coverage_custody_forgeable.reproduced: A directly constructed RecursiveCoverageCustody with a real handoff_ref but an arbitrary coverage_record_ref and arbitrary completeness_state was accepted and authorized the envelope.
correction: RecursiveCoverageCustody is token-guarded; only from_handoff may mint one.
from_handoff requires the exact RecursiveBranchHandoff type (not duck typing).
The coverage record is always handoff.evaluated_frontier_ref; a caller cannot substitute another ref.
The custody binds the handoff's internally retained scope identity (candidate universe definition, winning predicate, discovery authority, branch replay binding) as deterministic content hashes.

completeness_state was REMOVED from the custody entirely. RecursiveBranchHandoff does not own a completeness grade, so recording one let a caller assert coverage completeness the owner never produced. from_handoff no longer accepts such a parameter.
Added OwnerStateProjection.from_recursive_handoff(handoff, custody) so positive handoff state is never built by direct projection construction; custody is a required argument.
